body:
Sure! Here's a complete plugin description for UltraRules:

🎯 UltraRules - Ultimate Server Rules Plugin
The most customizable and feature-rich rules plugin for your Minecraft server!
📖 Overview
UltraRules is a powerful, fully customizable rules management plugin that allows server administrators to create, display, and manage server rules with ease. Whether you run a small survival server or a large network, UltraRules provides everything you need to keep your players informed and your server organized.
✨ Features
🎨 Fully Customizable

Complete control over rule content, formatting, and colors
Support for all Minecraft color codes and formatting
Customizable messages, titles, and headers
Configurable GUI menus with custom items and lore

🎮 User-Friendly GUI

Beautiful, intuitive book-style interface
Pagination support for unlimited rules
Clickable buttons for navigation
Custom rule icons and descriptions
Search functionality

🎯 Commands

- /rules - opens the rules

- /rules reload - reloads the yml file


🔑 Permissions

ultrarules.reload - reloads the plugin!

⚙️ Configuration
Fully customizable config.yml with options for:

Rule display format and colors
GUI layout and items
Join messages and requirements
Rule categories and organization
Punishment systems
Database settings (MySQL/SQLite support)

📦 Installation

Download UltraRules.jar
Place in your server's plugins folder
Restart your server
Edit config.yml to customize
Use /rules reload to apply changes

🔄 Updates & Support

Always Updated and showed in the changelog

💎 Why Choose UltraRules?

✅ Lightweight - Optimized performance, minimal server impact
✅ Reliable - Thoroughly tested on 1.21+
✅ Modern - Clean code, active development
✅ Free - 100% free and open source
✅ Compatible - Works with Spigot, Paper, Purpur

Survival servers
Creative servers
Minigame networks
Roleplay servers
Prison servers
Any server that needs organized rules!
